evals.prompt: Write the chronicle entry for issue 27 in vegastack/docs-tools (`feat: --json flag for check-links`), branch feat/27-json-flag, built by claude, approved by kmanojkumar; the evidence comment is attached. dev.md says `chronicle-style: plain`, `emoji: none`. Today is 03-09-2026.
evals.expected_output: One entry in the chronicle format: a dated heading whose title names the outcome for a human, the issue as a full markdown link, the five list fields What / Why / How it went / Changed / Decisions in plain language, and the footer line — ready to prepend to `.vegastack/chronicle.md`.
assertions: The heading is `## 03-09-2026 — <title> ([#27](https://github.com/vegastack/docs-tools/issues/27))` and the title names an outcome, not a mechanism or commit subject
The five fields What, Why, How it went, Changed, Decisions are present as list items in that order
The footer reads `— approved by (kmanojkumar) · built by claude · branch feat/27-json-flag` after a blank line
No bare `#27` appears anywhere in the entry
How it went records the review's reverted rename honestly rather than saying only `smooth`

evals.prompt: catch me up on this project — I've been away a month. the chronicle is attached
evals.expected_output: A three-part digest in plain language: the story so far, the recent chapters one line each, and the open threads — built only from the attached chronicle, in chronological order, naming no event the file does not contain.
assertions: The digest has the three parts: the story so far, recent chapters, open threads
Recent chapters are listed one line each, in chronological order, with the date and outcome title
Every event mentioned appears in the attached chronicle; nothing is invented
The recorded decision (PDF rendering stays pure Node) is named

evals.prompt: what's in flight right now in vegastack/billing?
evals.expected_output: The request is routed to dev-status — the live board is its job — and no digest is written.
assertions: The response names `dev-status` as the skill for the live board
No digest or chronicle entry is written
The response does not guess the current board state
